description.value: The family-owned Dilworth Inn is a pet-friendly hotel located across from Orchard Park Shopping Centre and steps from Mill Creek Linear Park, about 10 minutes from downtown Kelowna. All room types include complimentary continental breakfast and free Wi-Fi, with options ranging from standard queens to kitchenette suites. Its location adjacent to Highway 97 makes it a practical stop for cyclists passing through the Kelowna corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates all OSM contact fields (phone, address, email, website). The amenities page and rooms page confirm free Wi-Fi and walking-distance restaurants/bars. No mention of bike storage, laundry, tools, e-bike charging, or any cyclist-specific services anywhere on the site, so those fields remain null per evidence rules.
concerns: Indoor pool is temporarily closed as of May 30th per the amenities page ('INDOOR POOL IS TEMPORARILY CLOSED - May 30th'); not cyclist-critical but worth noting for guest experience.
OSM lists only the local phone number (+1-250-762-9666); website also advertises a toll-free number (1-800-762-3881) not in OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating hotel with an active website and bookable rooms. Useful overnight stop for touring cyclists in the Kelowna area.

Nearby evening food.detail: Rooms page states the inn is 'within easy walking distance of a selection of restaurants and bars'
